author_prompt:
Author 8 DIFFERENT natural ecommerce customer-service dialogue families in en.
Batch 20; ensure at least four current turns classified as order_logistics across this batch.
Each family has its OWN coherent history of 2, 4 or 6 short alternating user/assistant
messages, followed by 3 ALTERNATIVE current user turns, not three sequential turns.
Those alternatives differ in effective intent: retain vs replace, withdraw vs
continue, single goal vs concurrent goal, or resolved vs unresolved reference.
Include natural short answers where history matters. Vary old completed tasks,
hesitation, self-correction, indirect wording, topics and dialogue acts. General
and human-service requests must also occur as NEW goals, not only stale history.
Do not follow a repeated sentence template or substitute product nouns to create
new families. Avoid stereotyped 'information only, do not submit' repetition.
Invent broad everyday ecommerce situations; no copied benchmark or private data.
History plus current turn should fit 150 English words or 180 Chinese characters;
keep it compact but meaningful. No future replies or final conversation summaries.
Supply the correct label for each alternative according to the rubric.

families.scenario: Customer ordered a desk lamp but the package shows delivered while they never received it.

messages.content: Hi, my order #48291 for the LED desk lamp says delivered yesterday but I never got it.
I'm sorry to hear that. Let me check the tracking details for order #48291.
Thanks. The photo they uploaded just shows a doorstep, not my door.
I understand. I'll open a delivery investigation with the carrier. It usually takes 2-3 business days.

variants.text: Okay, please go ahead with that investigation.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Actually, forget it — my neighbor found the package on their porch and brought it over.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Wait, before that — does this lamp come with a dimmer switch? I might have ordered the wrong model.
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer asks about returning a pair of running shoes bought two weeks ago.

messages.content: I bought the TrailBlazer running shoes two weeks ago and they're too narrow.
I can help with that. Our return window is 30 days from delivery for unworn items.
They're basically unworn, just tried on indoors. Can I swap for a wide fit?
Yes, exchanges are available. I can generate a prepaid return label for you.

variants.text: Great, send me the label. Also, do you carry these in a half-size up?
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Actually, I'd rather just keep them and buy insoles instead. Cancel the return.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Hold on — I also want to check why my account shows two charges for this order.
variants.label: billing_refund

families.scenario: Customer's order was split into two shipments and one part is missing.

messages.content: My order #7731 arrived but only half of it — the coffee maker came, no filters.
Let me look into that. Orders can ship in separate boxes with different tracking numbers.
Oh, I see. So there might be a second package still on the way?
Yes, I can see a second shipment that left our warehouse yesterday.

variants.text: Perfect, then I'll just wait for it. Thanks for checking.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Actually, I need to change the delivery address for that second box — I'm traveling next week.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: By the way, is the coffee maker dishwasher-safe? The manual didn't say.
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer wants to cancel a subscription box before the next billing cycle.

messages.content: I signed up for the monthly snack box but I want to cancel before the next charge.
I can help you cancel. Your next billing date is the 15th, so there's plenty of time.
Good. Will I still get this month's box if I cancel now?
Yes, the current month's box is already processed and will ship as scheduled.

variants.text: Alright, cancel it then. I'll enjoy this last box.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Hmm, actually can I pause instead of cancel? I might restart in a few months.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Wait — I never got the confirmation email when I signed up. Can you resend it?
variants.label: account_security

families.scenario: Customer received a damaged ceramic vase and wants a replacement.

messages.content: The ceramic vase from order #2045 arrived cracked at the base.
I'm very sorry about that. I can send a replacement or issue a refund — which do you prefer?
A replacement would be nice, but I'm worried it'll break again in shipping.
Understood. We'll use extra bubble wrap and double-boxing for the replacement.

variants.text: Okay, send the replacement then. Thanks for the extra care.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: You know what, just refund me instead. I'll buy one locally.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Actually, can you tell me if this vase is food-safe? I wanted to use it for fruit.
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer is locked out of their account after a password reset.

messages.content: I can't log in after resetting my password — it says my email isn't recognized.
Let me verify your account. Could you confirm the email you used at signup?
It's j.martinez@mail.com, but I might have used a different one back then.
I found an account under jmartinez@mail.com. Would you like me to send a reset link there?

variants.text: Yes, send it to that address please.
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Actually, I don't remember which email I used at all. Can you look up by phone number?
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Before that — I have a pending order I need to check on. Can you look it up by name?
variants.label: order_logistics

families.scenario: Customer asks about a discount code that isn't working at checkout.

messages.content: My promo code SAVE20 isn't working at checkout. It says invalid.
Let me check that code. SAVE20 is valid for orders over $75 on select items.
My cart is $89 but maybe some items are excluded from the promo.
That's likely it. The code excludes electronics and already-discounted items.

variants.text: Got it, I'll remove the headphones from my cart and try again. Thanks!
variants.label: general

variants.text: Can you just apply the discount manually if I keep everything in the cart?
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: I see. By the way, are these headphones noise-cancelling? The listing was unclear.
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer's delivery was left at the wrong building and they are frustrated.

messages.content: This is the second time my package was left at the wrong building. I'm really frustrated.
I sincerely apologize for the repeated issue. Let me escalate this to our delivery team.
I've already called twice about this. I want to speak to a supervisor.
I understand your frustration. I can transfer you to our customer relations team.

variants.text: Fine, transfer me. I want this resolved properly this time.
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: Actually, just tell me — will the next delivery come to the correct address or not?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: You know what, never mind. I'll just pick it up from the courier depot myself.
variants.label: order_logistics
